name: HZ_CERTIFICATIONS
description: The HZ_CERTIFICATIONS table stores information about accreditation that is awarded to a company by an independent, third party organization. For example, this table would be used to capture information such as, a full ISO 9001, "Registered Firm" Status granted to a company or an IQNet certification awarded to a company.

columns.name: CERTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Certification identifier

columns.name: CERTIFICATION_NAME
columns.description: The name of the certification such as ISO9000 and GMP001.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATUS
columns.description: Name for the status of the certification. For example, applied for, granted, or expired.

columns.name: EXPIRES_ON_DATE
columns.description: Date when certification expires.

columns.name: GRADE
columns.description: Level or grade of certification provided by the ISSUED_BY_AUTHORITY. For example, founding member, gold, fully certified, partially certified.

columns.name: ISSUED_BY_AUTHORITY
columns.description: The name of the certifying authority.

columns.name: ISSUED_ON_DATE
columns.description: Date when a certification was issued.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
